method: Every command was run against a scratch run directory created by `eaos init` over examples/benchmark/coupled-billing, and its handler read. A verdict of "replaced" means the declared pipeline answers the same question for the same input, not that the words match.

subsystems.agent_led_workflow: Guides a human or agent through a staged audit of a run directory: scan, next action, observations, roadmap, module plan, record validation, report, resume. The declared pipeline now does this deterministically and in one command.
subsystems.model_driven_repair: Copies the target into an isolated project, asks a model for a repair, runs the declared checks before and after, and emits changes.patch. It never writes into the target. Nothing in the deterministic pipeline does this.

commands.what_it_does: init plus workflow.initialize, discovery.scan and AGENT-START.md
commands.evidence: eaos audit runs 16 declared stages over the same target and reports what each did

commands.what_it_does: Scan the run inventory and classify files
commands.evidence: facts/index.json carries the same inventory, content-addressed and reproducible

commands.what_it_does: Print the next workflow stage for an agent to perform
commands.evidence: fails without workflow.json, which only legacy-audit writes; RUN.md states stage status for every run

commands.what_it_does: Record a human observation against a file line range
commands.evidence: decision-review records a sourced human review and refreshes the plan from it
fails without roadmap.json; the plan stage produces ordered waves from confirmed claims

commands.what_it_does: Write plan.md listing every audit module from the registry
commands.evidence: produces a static module listing, not a plan derived from this project

commands.what_it_does: Check the run records against their schemas
commands.evidence: the output contract R1-R13 checks the rendered report; audit_records stays as a library

commands.what_it_does: Render report.md from the workflow records
commands.evidence: both are produced by declared stages with budgets the contract enforces

commands.what_it_does: Report whether the recorded evidence is still current
commands.evidence: resume compares the source fingerprint and reruns only stages that did not complete

commands.what_it_does: Hash the run records and write a resumption note
commands.evidence: the manifest records per-stage status, artifacts and the source fingerprint

commands.what_it_does: Create the run workspace the model-driven repair path operates in
commands.evidence: run, continue, implement, improve, packet, graph, impact and context all need this workspace

commands.what_it_does: Model-driven audit: multi-round interrogation with a budget, writing architecture.json
commands.modern_equivalent: the semantic stage does one pass, not a bounded multi-round interrogation
commands.evidence: eaos audit --provider runs semantic once; this drives rounds against a character budget

commands.what_it_does: Resume a blocked model-driven run, reusing completed jobs
commands.evidence: no deterministic stage resumes a model interrogation

commands.what_it_does: Ask a model for a repair inside an isolated copy, run the declared checks before and after, and emit changes.patch
commands.evidence: remediate.py copies the target into project/ and edits the copy; the target is never written

commands.what_it_does: Loop audit and repair until a stop condition, writing CAMPAIGN.md
Build a character-budgeted context packet over untrusted source, refusing to exceed the budget
commands.modern_equivalent: bundles/ groups artifacts but does not bound source excerpts or mark them untrusted
commands.evidence: the packet refuses rather than truncates, and labels every excerpt UNTRUSTED

commands.what_it_does: Summarise the architecture model the model-driven run produced
commands.modern_equivalent: SYSTEM-MAP.md is derived from facts, not from the declared model
commands.evidence: reads architecture.json, which only the model path writes

commands.what_it_does: Impact of a change over the declared architecture model
commands.modern_equivalent: eaos impact-of computes impact from resolved imports instead
commands.evidence: different input: a reviewed model rather than extracted facts

commands.what_it_does: Budgeted context slice of the declared architecture model
